dcat_keyword_sm: Vegetation, trees, University of Waterloo campus, regeneration
dct_description_sm: Data were collected and compiled by students in a third year course, students ranged from second to fourth year of study

Students in a field ecosystem assessment course (ERS 340) conducted a vegetation sampling survey in two different areas on the University of Waterloo campus over two days in May 2022. They identified ground vegetation, shrubs and saplings, sub-canopy and canopy trees as well as regeneration modules within the sampling plots as per the Vegetation Sampling Protocol (VSP) methodology (http://forests-settled-urban-landscapes.org/VSP/).
